subject: Regional user group — spend guardrails & reimbursement process
messages:
From: Samir Rao <organizers@midwestdev.org>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Redwood at MidwestDev — vendor payment / spend cap question

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for confirming Redwood as a gold sponsor for the Chicago user group on Dec 10. Quick question on finance so we can finalize vendor timelines: our production vendor (EventHorizons) needs either a PO or a receivable deposit by Dec 3 to hold the venue. Can Redwood issue a PO for the deposit? If Redwood prefers reimbursements instead, we need to know the maximum sponsor spend cap you can commit to so we can plan the deposit and swag purchases.

Attached is a preliminary budget breakdown (EventBudgetBreakdown.xlsx) showing line-items: venue deposit, A/V, swag, and speaker travel. Please let me know the preferred path and any required vendor docs.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
MidwestDev Community
organizers@midwestdev.org

Attachments: EventBudgetBreakdown.xlsx

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <organizers@midwestdev.org>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood at MidwestDev — vendor payment / spend cap question

Hi Samir —

Appreciate the file; this is helpful. Two quick items from our side:

1) Preferred flow: PO from Redwood to EventHorizons (procurement-friendly) — that keeps vendor payments on schedule. Reimbursements are OK for ad-hoc speaker expenses (<$500), but vendor invoices should go through procurement when possible.

2) Preliminary spend cap: we can commit up to $6,500 for the core sponsorship deliverables today (venue deposit + basic A/V + standard swag). If you need more (e.g., premium A/V or extra headcount support), flag the line-item and we can discuss a stretch approval.

Ben — can you confirm cost-center / GL mapping and any PO limits we should tell the vendor? Also, Vanessa and I will collect the vendor SOW and W-9 before PO creation.

Samir — please confirm EventHorizons' remit address and billing email so Ben can loop procurement.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <organizers@midwestdev.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:37:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood at MidwestDev — vendor payment / spend cap question

Adding logistics detail from the events team:

- Typical schedule: 50% deposit to secure venue, remainder within 14 days of event.
- Swag: we plan for 400 shirts and 600 stickers; estimated swag line is ~$1,200 in the budget file. Any extra premium swag should be pre-approved.
- Travel: expect 2 speaker flights and 1 hotel night each. Traveler reimbursements should follow Redwood travel policy (receipts required).

I'll attach SOW once EventHorizons returns it. For now, Steph's PO route sounds good.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <organizers@midwestdev.org>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood at MidwestDev — vendor payment / spend cap question

Hi all —

Finance + procurement notes for PO creation:

- Cost center: 4050-ENG-MKT
- GL account: 5602 (Event Sponsorships)
- Default PO ceiling for events team: $7,500; anything above requires director sign-off (Lauren Bishop).
- Required vendor documents: signed SOW and vendor W-9 (vendor_W9_EventHorizons.pdf). Please attach these to the Coupa PO.
- Payment terms: net 30 from invoice date once PO and invoice are matched.

Samir — we need the vendor remit address and billing email. Once we have SOW and W-9, Stephanie/Vanessa can submit the PO request here: https://coupa.company.internal/purchase/new?ref=EVT-9872. Procurement will route for approval within 24 hours.

I attached the W-9 I have on file from EventHorizons.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: vendor_W9_EventHorizons.pdf, SOW_EventHorizons.pdf

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <organizers@midwestdev.org>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood at MidwestDev — vendor payment / spend cap question

Samir — great, thanks for the patience. Per Ben's note below, we'll proceed with a PO (preferred). Action plan:

1) Vanessa and I will upload the SOW and W-9 to Coupa and create a PO for $6,500 (under the $7,500 default ceiling).
2) Procurement will route for approvals; Ben, please expedite if you see anything missing.
3) Samir — can you confirm the vendor billing contact (email) and remit address so I can populate the PO? Also confirm whether EventHorizons needs a 50% deposit now or prefers full invoice after the event.

Forwarded for context: On Fri, Nov 27, 2026 at 11:22 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote: (see required cost-center and PO guidance)

I'll loop Lauren for director-level approval only if we need to exceed $7,500.

Thanks everyone — I'll post the Coupa PO link once created.

Best,
Stephanie
